title: Principal-power quotient ring sheaves
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in a chosen coefficient universe, let $B$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and let $t\in\Gamma(\mathcal C,B)$. For $n\geq 1$, define the quotient ring sheaf $R_n=B/t^nB$ to be the sheafification, in commutative rings, of the presheaf $U\mapsto B(U)/(t_U^n)$. Its restriction along $f:V\to U$ sends $[b]$ to $[b|_V]$: naturality of $t$ makes this well-defined, and these maps satisfy the identity and composition laws. The natural projections $B(U)\to B(U)/(t_U^n)$ followed by the sheafification unit give the canonical ring-sheaf projection $\pi_n:B\to R_n$. The same formulas define $R_0=0$ as a harmless index convention.
